SELECT
  COALESCE((SELECT state_json FROM public.conversation_state WHERE conversation_key=$1), '{}'::jsonb) AS state_json,
  COALESCE((SELECT cart_json  FROM public.carts WHERE conversation_key=$1),  '{"items":[]}'::jsonb) AS cart_json,
  (SELECT locale FROM public.customer_preferences WHERE tenant_id=$2 AND phone=$3) AS pref_locale,
  (SELECT row_to_json(sc) FROM public.system_configs sc LIMIT 1) AS system_config,
  COALESCE((
    SELECT jsonb_object_agg(x.key||'::'||x.locale, x.content)
    FROM (
      SELECT DISTINCT ON (key, locale)
        key, locale, content
      FROM public.message_templates
      WHERE (tenant_id=$2 OR tenant_id='_GLOBAL')
        AND locale IN ('fr','ar')
      ORDER BY key, locale, CASE WHEN tenant_id=$2 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
    ) x
  ), '{}'::jsonb) AS templates_json,
  COALESCE((
    SELECT jsonb_object_agg(x.key||'::'||x.locale, x.variables)
    FROM (
      SELECT DISTINCT ON (key, locale)
        key, locale, variables
      FROM public.message_templates
      WHERE (tenant_id=$2 OR tenant_id='_GLOBAL')
        AND locale IN ('fr','ar')
      ORDER BY key, locale, CASE WHEN tenant_id=$2 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
    ) x
  ), '{}'::jsonb) AS template_vars_json;

INSERT INTO security_events(tenant_id, restaurant_id, conversation_key, channel, user_id, event_type, severity, payload_json)
VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,'AUDIO_URL_BLOCKED','HIGH',
jsonb_build_object('reason',$6,'host',$7,'audio_url',$8,'trace_id',$9))
RETURNING 1;

SELECT
      $1::text AS restaurant_id,
      COALESCE((
        SELECT jsonb_agg(row_to_json(mi)) FROM (
          SELECT item_code, label, price_cents, category
          FROM menu_items
          WHERE restaurant_id=$1 AND active=true
          ORDER BY category, item_code
        ) mi
      ), '[]'::jsonb) AS items,
      COALESCE((
        SELECT jsonb_agg(row_to_json(mo)) FROM (
          SELECT option_code, item_code, label, kind, price_delta_cents
          FROM menu_item_options
          WHERE restaurant_id=$1 AND active=true
          ORDER BY item_code, option_code
        ) mo
      ), '[]'::jsonb) AS options;

WITH up_state AS (
  INSERT INTO public.conversation_state (conversation_key, tenant_id, restaurant_id, channel, user_id, state_json)
  VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6::jsonb)
  ON CONFLICT (conversation_key) DO UPDATE
    SET state_json=EXCLUDED.state_json, updated_at=now()
  RETURNING 1
),
up_cart AS (
  INSERT INTO public.carts (conversation_key, cart_json)
  VALUES ($1, $7::jsonb)
  ON CONFLICT (conversation_key) DO UPDATE
    SET cart_json=EXCLUDED.cart_json, updated_at=now()
  RETURNING 1
),
up_pref AS (
  INSERT INTO public.customer_preferences(tenant_id, phone, locale)
  SELECT $2, $5, $9
  WHERE COALESCE($8::boolean,false) = true
    AND $9 IS NOT NULL
    AND length(trim($9)) > 0
  ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, phone) DO UPDATE
    SET locale=EXCLUDED.locale, updated_at=now()
  RETURNING 1
)
SELECT 1 AS ok;

INSERT INTO outbound_messages(dedupe_key, tenant_id, restaurant_id, conversation_key, channel, user_id, order_id, template, payload_json, status, next_retry_at, updated_at)
VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,$8,$9,'PENDING', now(), now())
ON CONFLICT (dedupe_key) DO UPDATE
  SET payload_json=EXCLUDED.payload_json,
      status = CASE WHEN outbound_messages.status='SENT' THEN outbound_messages.status ELSE 'PENDING' END,
      updated_at=now()
RETURNING outbound_id, status;
